text:
nora (Finance Ops): Kaplan-Med flagged two March invoices. One lacks the 'Reserved GPU hours' line (~$5,100). The other is a duplicate but shows CAD instead of USD. Both were emailed. Can we triage?

ash (Billing Eng): Looking. I can see invoice_job-11888 started then retried 8s later. The retry set TRANSIENT_RETRY=true which bypassed dedupe/validation. Likely read usage blob mid-write.

support-bot: alert invoice_system job-11888 retried (reason: storage PUT timeout). tasks: job-11888 / job-11888-retry.

dylan (Revenue Ops): Customer says: "INV-2026-0342.pdf (no reserved line) and INV-2026-0342-copy.pdf (CAD amounts). Which one is correct?" They need corrected invoice + credit note.

viv (Accounting): We need corrected PDF + CN referencing duplicate before EOD to avoid payment delay. VAT incorrectly set to 0% too; customer has VAT reg.

ash (Billing Eng): Log snippet:
```
2026-04-05T09:21:11Z INFO invoice_job-11888 start
2026-04-05T09:21:12Z ERROR storage PUT /tmp/inv_INV-2026-0342.pdf timeout
2026-04-05T09:21:13Z INFO retry job-11888-retry
2026-04-05T09:21:15Z INFO job-11888-retry completed (wrote INV-2026-0342.pdf)
2026-04-05T09:21:16Z INFO postprocess validation skipped (TRANSIENT_RETRY=true)
```
Root cause: retry skipped dedupe and read partial usage blob. Plan: 1) patch generator to never skip validation on retries; 2) ensure invoice job waits for aggregator commit; 3) re-run invoice job for affected accounts; 4) issue credit notes for duplicates.

nora (Finance Ops): Approve re-issue + credit note for Kaplan-Med. Please include original filenames and a brief explanation in the PDF footer.

dylan (Revenue Ops): Add canned customer text: "We mistakenly sent duplicate invoice PDFs due to an internal retry; please rely on the corrected invoice and attached credit note."

viv (Accounting): Approved. Send corrected invoice to billing@kaplan-med.com and cc:acct@kaplan-med.com. We'll hold capture until corrected doc arrives.

ash (Billing Eng): Patching now and will run manual reissue when staging CI passes. ETA ~3 hours. Creating ticket BILL-1422 and CN-2026-0053.

nora (Finance Ops): Also add temporary pre-send validation: if expected line items (usage > 0) are missing, mark invoice STATUS=BLOCKED and stop sending. We can't have multiple sends.

ash (Billing Eng): Will add that. I'll include RCA and remediation in BILL-1422 and tag eng-sre for storage consistency review.

dylan (Revenue Ops): I'll notify customer with ETA and block automated payment capture.

nora (Finance Ops): Thanks. Please update the ticket with root cause and remediation for the monthly billing review. :eyes:
